SELECT /*+ gather_plan_statistics */ c.city, COUNT(*) FROM pl_orders o
JOIN pl_customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'open' AND
o.total > 100 GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY 2 DESC
